definitions.full: H2197. zaaph זַ֫עַף noun masculine storming, raging, rage (in poetry and late) — ׳ז absolute 2Chr 16:10 ; 28:9 ; construct Isa 30:30 2 t.; suffix זַעְמּוֺ Jonah 1:15 ; — 1 rage of king, leading to violence Prov 19:12 (|| כַּכְּפִיר נַהַם ), 2Chr 16:10 ( ׳בְּ עַלזֿאת עִמּוֺ ; || כעס ), 28:9 ; ׳ז אַף Isa 30:30 raging of anger (of ׳י ); ׳ז ׳י Micah 7:9 . 2 raging of sea Jonah 1:15 .
